notes.title: Warforged Content Update #3
notes.content:
This update features the first world boss, the lich. 




--Patch Notes--


-Lich Tower: Slay a lich to claim one of two powerful artifacts.

-Archery camera polishing.

-Raised dwarf camera position.

-Fixed body/head skin tone matching.

-UI text upgrades.

-Balance tweaks.

-Misc bug fixes.

-Player army movement speed increased.

notes.title: Warforged Content Update #2. Now available for $9.99.
notes.content:
This update features mostly upgrading and polishing of current content, along with a small number of additions.


--Patch Notes--


-Faction AI has been upgraded. Factions will now attempt to expand their territory.

-Bandit Factions: Bandits now create raiding camps outside your towns. Each bandit faction has a stronghold, destroy a stronghold to stop raiding camps from that faction. 
Note - This was added last week, but I did not include any patch notes.

-Command posts are now fully functional. Building a command post will station a defensive army outside the town. Upgrade the command post to increase the strength of this army. These armies will respawn at the start of every week.

-NPC sieging has been reworked.

-Agility will now increase maximum stamina.

-Players can now remove troops from their army.

-Balance tweaks.

-Bug fixes.

notes.title: Warforged Patch Notes 4/14-4/21
notes.content:
Rolled out a number of small updates throughout this past week, here is an outline of what they contained. Note: This is not a full Content Update. I expect to be finished with the second Content Update within 1-2 weeks.

-Patch Notes-

-Multi-display support.

-Minor Character Screen UI upgrade.

-Slight increase to army travel speed.

-Small tutorial changes.

-Multiple bug fixes.

notes.title: Warforged Content Update #1
notes.content:
The first Content Update is now live! We had a wild launch week filled with bug fixing, but managed to get some additions done as well. Huge thank you to all Early Access supporters so far! The following is patch notes for the first Warforged Content Update:

---Gameplay Changes---

-Weapon and Magic types now have different effects:
-Fire Magic burns.
-Swords/Arrows will cause Bleeding.
-Ice Magic can Root.
-Blunt weapons can Stun.
-Axes can Critical hit.
-Lightning Magic can Critical hit.

-High tier unit health has been increased.


---New Content---

-Stables can now be built at any town. Stables give access to mounts for your army, increasing Campaign Map movement speed at the cost of additional upkeep.

-Random rogue army ambushes and sieges.

notes.title: Warforged Launch Update #2
notes.content:
---Gameplay Changes---

-Sprint stamina cost has been increased.

-Mana regeneration has been removed from the game. Max mana bonus' from wisdom and mage armor have been increased to compensate.

-Bounty danger scaling is now working correctly.

-Unit damage has been fixed, they were much lower than intended.

-Bug fixes.

notes.title: Warforged Launch Hotfix
notes.content:
Rolled a few small updates out that will hopefully fix weapon swapping, unit purchasing, and clean up autosave issues that players are experiencing.

If you encounter a bug, drop a comment on the "Warforged Bug Reports" Community Thread and I will look into it ASAP.

Apologies for any frustration caused by those annoying bugs. Thanks everyone!
